business_problem: MiniMax needed a more elastic and reliable way to preprocess PB-scale multimodal training data for rapidly iterating foundation models. Its earlier Python-centric workflows struggled with OOM errors, file-size limits, limited visibility, and the operational cost of maintaining custom data-processing pipelines.
solution_summary: MiniMax built a fully managed Data+AI preprocessing platform on Alibaba Cloud around MaxCompute and MaxFrame so large-model training could draw on a stable, elastic data pipeline. Raw structured and unstructured corpora are kept in MaxCompute, while MaxFrame gives the team a unified Python development experience with distributed operators such as Pandas-compatible transforms and MinHash deduplication. The platform supports large-scale preprocessing, batch inference, and multimodal data operations that previously suffered from memory blowups, file-size bottlenecks, or fragile homegrown scripts. Elastic CPU resources can scale to tens of thousands of cores for short preprocessing bursts, and MaxCompute's storage tiering cuts historical retention cost for colder data. Around that core, DataWorks provides managed development and orchestration while Hologres supports downstream interactive analysis, giving MiniMax a single cloud-native data estate for training-oriented AI workflows.

solution_components.name: MaxCompute
solution_components.role: Stores and processes the large structured and unstructured datasets used in MiniMax model-data workflows.

solution_components.name: MaxFrame
solution_components.role: Provides the distributed Python processing framework for preprocessing, deduplication, and batch inference jobs.

solution_components.name: DataWorks
solution_components.role: Handles managed development, orchestration, and operations around the Data+AI pipeline.

solution_components.name: Hologres
solution_components.role: Supports downstream interactive analysis on processed data assets.

data_flow: Multimodal raw data lands in MaxCompute, where MaxFrame runs preprocessing, classification, deduplication, and batch inference tasks on elastic CPU capacity. The refined datasets are then handed to downstream training and analysis workflows, with DataWorks managing pipelines and Hologres exposing processed results for interactive use.
business_outcome: MiniMax raised resource efficiency while cutting the cost and operations burden of large-scale AI data preparation. The company can now burst to very large CPU pools for preprocessing, keep historical data cheaper through storage tiering, and run a managed Data+AI workflow that supports global model and application expansion with less infrastructure toil.
